ambiguities.reason: Promotion funding shares do not sum to 100%: 60% platform + 60% seller.
ambiguities.source_quote: . Discounts under the Platform's festive campaign shall be funded 60% by the Platform. Discounts under any seller-elected campaign shall be funded 60% by the Seller. Where an order qualifies under both campaigns the discount shall be funded under both clauses.

commission.source_quote: . The Platform shall retain a commission of twenty-two percent (22%) of the Net Order Value.

delivery_fee.source_quote: . A delivery fee of Rs. 45.00 per confirmed delivery is payable to the assigned delivery partner.

hold.source_quote: . The Seller's share shall become payable upon confirmation of delivery, and shall be settled no earlier than 24 hours thereafter.

promotion_funding.source_quote: . Discounts under the Platform's festive campaign shall be funded 60% by the Platform. Discounts under any seller-elected campaign shall be funded 60% by the Seller. Where an order qualifies under both campaigns the discount shall be funded under both clauses.

provenance.notes: SYNTHETIC contract corpus — not a real merchant agreement.

refund.source_quote: . Where a refund is issued the Seller payout shall first be reversed. Commission is refundable.

tax.source_quote: . The Platform shall withhold tax at source at one percent (1%) of the commission amount.
